result.title: Projecting Beauty: Transferring Image Aesthetic Analysis onto 3D Heritage and Urban Scenes
result.summary: Judgments about the beauty of buildings and streets inform architectural design, urban planning, and heritage conservation, yet increasingly rely on scanned 3D models over material fabric. Automatic aesthetic assessment remains largely confined to 2D photographs. We ask what survives when image aesthetic assessment crosses this dimensional gap to produce dense, per-point aesthetic descriptions of heritage and urban point clouds. We examine three routes that sidestep costly, and sometimes ethically dubious, human labeling at scale: (1) lifting scalar scores from image aesthetic models (NIMA, SAAN) onto geometry; (2) training Aesthetic Visual Analysis (AVA) regression heads on frozen vision backbones (DINOv3, TIPS, SigLIP2, PE, RADSeg) or, in a 3D-native variant, a generalist point encoder on feed-forward AVA reconstructions; and (3) querying lifted vision-language features with a natural-language aesthetic label, taking similarity as a score. The two supervised routes transfer poorly: heads fitting AVA in-domain produce architectural class profiles that neither reproduce one another nor track other signals, while the 3D-native probe stays near chance due to reconstruction geometry quality. Text querying is markedly more coherent. Projecting out the class-text direction from point features raises mean cross-model agreement on architectural part profiles from +0.035 to +0.352, and from +0.113 to +0.293 per point; the four backbones passing a semantic sanity check correlate at 0.31-0.73, while the failing one remains an outlier. Since model agreement is not agreement with human aesthetic perception, we detail a part-aware rating protocol to clarify where human and automatic ratings disagree. We provide a reproducible transfer protocol, an account of which pseudo-labeling routes carry signal, and dense aesthetic pseudo-labels meant as hypotheses rather than ground truth.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究把图像美学评估迁移到3D遗产与城市场景点云，比较三种避开大规模人工标注的密集美学伪标签路线（分数提升、冻结骨干回归头、视觉语言文本查询），发现文本查询最连贯，并设计部件级人工评分协议以定位人机分歧。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「从特征中投影去除类文本方向以提升跨模型一致性」及以跨模型一致性检验伪标签可靠性的做法，可能可供核查如何在latent状态中分离任务相关内容与语义干扰、以及如何评估表示相似度的可信度，但与LVR推理机制无直接联系。
